entries.zh: 细签；（折扇）扇骨、扇轴的细竹签
entries.en: small stick; the thin rib or pivot that joins a fan
entries.notes: H栏「弱眼」字形可疑、R栏空缺，释义据L栏 abanillo（扇）与M音推断。

entries.zh: 蒲葵（棕榈科，叶可制扇）；棕榈树

entries.en: palm of the hand; hollow of the palm
entries.notes: R栏「bat say」与官话对音不合，疑栏位错置；据H「掌」与M「chiù̃-sīm（掌心）」定夺。
H首字「搭/拾」存疑，据L palmadas 与 M 音定夺。

entries.en: to slap, to strike (with a fan)

entries.zh: 小板；戒尺（责打手心的木片）
entries.en: small board; ferule or paddle for smacking the palm
entries.notes: L栏有〔疑〕，H「個枋」与M「guī-pang」未尽合；palmeta 在马尼拉语境指打手心的木片。

entries.zh: 打手心；掌责（以木板责打手掌）
entries.en: to smack the palm (as a punishment)
entries.notes: L栏有〔疑〕，与上条 palmeta（戒尺）相应，据H「打手掌」定夺。

entries.zh: 筷子；进食用的木箸（词头另训「树木、木料」）
entries.en: chopsticks; eating sticks (the headword is also glossed 'tree, timber')
entries.notes: M栏残损（T99），据H「箸」与L「palillo para comer」定夺。

entries.zh: 灯芯签；油灯中架托灯芯的细签
entries.en: wick stick; the splinter that holds the wick in an oil lamp
entries.notes: H第二字「桃/條」存疑，L栏「nel candil」语义明白，据以定夺。

entries.en: brush pot; tube in which writing brushes are placed
entries.notes: M「fāng」与H「筒」常读不合，据L「ponen los pinceles」定夺。
L栏残乱有〔疑〕，H「楠」与M「lām」清晰，据以定夺。

entries.en: bamboo; bamboo pole (for a palisade or fence)
entries.notes: L栏残乱，M栏有插符之疑，据H「竹」与M「chec」定夺。

entries.zh: 长棍；长约二布拉萨（两臂余）的对打木棍
entries.en: long fighting staves, two braças long
entries.notes: H「框」与L「con que pelean」不合，M栏音写残缺，释义依L栏。

entries.zh: 桅杆；撑持船帆的木杆（一说指烛签）
entries.en: mast; the pole that supports the sail (alternatively a candle spike)
entries.notes: L「vela」可指帆或烛，H「拴」与M「lêng pes」均不足定夺，两解并存。
